evidence.text: Depicts four hands (舁) working together (同) to raise something. The simplified character 兴 was adapted from the cursive form of the traditional character 興.
Depicts four hands (舁) working together (同) to raise something.

Phono-semantic compound (形聲 /形声, OC *qʰɯŋ, *qʰɯŋs): semantic 舁 + phonetic 型 (OC *ɡeːŋ).
Compare perhaps Burmese ရွှင် (hrwang, “to rejoice, be abundant”) (Luce, 1981).
